summary: PASS 26 / FAIL 7 / NOT_VERIFIABLE_OFFLINE 1 / N/A 1 (35 checks). Verdict: all 124 tx-fork v0.3.2 set values are reproducible from the archived deployment inputs (120 exact + 3 multiplier-formula + 1 runtime timestamp), all 124 DataStore keys and all 245 catalog hashes recompute correctly, no §4 removed key is present anywhere, and the §2 cards (MIN/MAX_DYNAMIC_SPREAD, COLLATERAL_TOKEN) match chain exactly. The FAILs are documentation/catalog gaps, not chain defects: 04 §3.2–3.5 wrongly state Config.setUint/whitelist for 5 DataStore-direct keys; 04 §3.6 default cells (MIN_SKEW_IMPACT 0, MAX_SKEW_IMPACT WBTC 10000000000000000) differ from deployed -5000000000000000 / 5000000000000000 (explained by market.sample.json Skew_Clamp_*); 3 market-prop bases (MARKET_INDEX/VAULT/INDEX_TOKEN, 6 rows) are uncatalogued; 33 chain-set bases have no literal 04 card (covered only via §5 底本 reference); 2 catalog 值类型 cells blank; and STABLE_PRICE(USDC) — set on the v0.3.1 tx-fork — is unset on v0.3.2 with no input or doc stating the intent. All §3.x '当前部署值 待回填' cells now have chain values in this report.
unexplained_mismatches: STABLE_PRICE|token=USDC: set on v0.3.1 tx-fork 260812 (1001000000000000000000000) but unset on v0.3.2 tx-fork (parameters.json 3 entries unset); mechanism is clear (no v0.3.2 configure script writes it; ChainlinkPriceFeedProvider.sol:49-58 then uses min=max=feed price) but no input, 04 card, or catalog note documents whether the anchor is intentionally dropped for v0.3.2 — owner decision needed before SCN-070-type price reconciliation on this fork.

Synthetic BTC token decimals: chain PRICE_FEED_MULTIPLIER (序号110) = 10000000000000000000000000000000000 follows configureOracle.ts:29-31 (non-USDC → 18 decimals), while TestCode manifest tx-fork-v0.3.2-260902.json markets[0].indexTokenDecimals = 8 and tokens.json WBTC decimals = 8 (parameters.json tokenMetadata decimals = null). Which decimals TestCode price/size math must use for MOCK-BTC is not documented; under 04:401's formula with 8 decimals the multiplier would be 10^44.

04:7 states the v0.3.1 底本's 119 '当前链上参数' rows come from tx-fork/260812, but several 底本 values do not match 260812 (or the base-sepolia/260729 spot check): e.g. 底本 row 118 MAX_PNL_FACTOR_FOR_ADL 750000000000000000000000000000 vs 260812/260729 550000000000000000000000000000; row 49 SKEW_IMPACT_FACTOR market#1 10000000000000000 vs 2500000000000000; row 51 MAX_OPEN_INTEREST 40000000000000000000000000000000000000 vs 100000000000000000000000000000000000000; rows 95-98 EXECUTION_FEE_SUBSIDIZE(_SIZE) listed 已设置 while 260812 probed them unset. These 底本 values coincide with the v0.3.2 tx-fork inputs instead; provenance of that column is unexplained (v0.3.1 document, outside A-3 scope but it feeds 04 §5's '底本' references).
caveats: Offline only: no RPC calls; chain truth is the block-46282993 snapshot (parameters.json) and its CSV mirror; the live read-check file (read-checks-live-2026-09-02.md, block 46283222) was only used as corroboration for §2.4-2.6.

Files deliberately not opened: source-tree scripts/parameters/market.sample.json and oracle.sample.json (pre-check hit 2 https URLs / 3 64-hex strings) — the archived configure-inputs copies under TestCase/config/v0.3.2/tx-fork/260902/ were used instead (their only URL hits are https://data.chain.link documentation links, domain-only extraction); scripts/configureOracle.ts was read with 64-hex values masked (single hit = ZERO_BYTES32 comparison); ignition/journal.jsonl was only grepped for futureId/type/args fields (its 431 64-hex strings are tx/block hashes per the snapshot README). No .env, pk.txt, mnemonic, noise-traders.json or Devconfig/ content was read.

Status vocabulary: the requested NOT_STATED outcome is expressed as 'card 当前部署值 待回填 → NOT_STATED' inside the PASS/FAIL rows for §3.2-§3.10 (the comparison there is against the card's 默认值/v0.3.1 参考值/精度 fields, which are stated); §2.4-2.6 (runtime state keys) are N/A.

§3.6 FAILs and the §3.2-3.5 write-entry FAIL are defects in 04-参数目录.md, not in the deployment: every deployed value is reproduced from the archived configure-inputs, and the Config.sol whitelist/catalog/scripts agree with each other.

Value recomputation reproduces the scripts' BigInt semantics (fraction truncation to scale digits; APR/31536000 truncation toward zero for negatives) — e.g. EXECUTION_FEE_SUBSIDIZE_SIZE market#1 = 333333333333333 from "0.000333333333333333"×1e18.

The 4 'raw' FX100Keys (LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD_BASE/_TIER_MULTIPLIER, EXECUTION_FEE_SUBSIDIZE/_SIZE) hash with keccak256(utf8) not keccak256(abi.encode(string)); the v0.3.2 snapshot handles this correctly (124/124 keys recomputed) but the v0.3.1 260812 by-module file appears to have probed them with abi.encode (EXECUTION_FEE_SUBSIDIZE* shown unset there), so v0.3.1→v0.3.2 comparisons for those 4 keys rely on the 底本 CSV values rather than 260812.

ChainlinkDataStreamProvider is enabled on tx-fork (IS_ORACLE_PROVIDER_ENABLED true) but no token is bound to it (feedId = 0 in oracle.fork.tx-fork.json); all three tokens use ChainlinkPriceFeedProvider 0x7ae5fdb923d25840fb4cee822c3d800a48ef6e90 — differs from the v0.3.1 tx-fork (DataStream provider) and must be reflected in any Oracle-path test expectations.

§5 'no change' was verified at key-definition level (git diff non-comment lines) and at value level only for market#1/#2, the three tokens and global keys; 34 same-dimension value differences vs the v0.3.1 tx-fork are listed and all trace to deployment inputs, so 'v0.3.1 部署参考值' cells in 04 must not be read as v0.3.2 expectations.
